## Professional Profile

I am an entry-level Economics and Data professional with completed **MPhil Economics coursework and thesis**, ongoing experience as a **Graduate Research Assistant**, three Data Science and AI/ML internships, and 29 documented multidisciplinary projects.

My background combines **Applied Economics, Econometrics, Economic Research, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, and Machine Learning**. I use Python, SQL, R, Stata, EViews, Excel, Power BI, and Tableau to clean and analyse data, develop models and forecasts, create dashboards, and communicate actionable insights.

## Areas of Expertise

- Economic research, applied econometrics, and policy analysis
- Quantitative analysis, statistical modelling, and time-series forecasting
- Data cleaning, validation, exploratory data analysis, and SQL analytics
- Power BI and Tableau dashboards, KPI reporting, and business intelligence
- Regression, classification, clustering, predictive modelling, NLP, and RAG
- Reproducible analysis, research documentation, and technical reporting

## Professional Experience

My experience includes faculty-supervised economic research at **Quaid-i-Azam University**, three analytics internships, and independent project work across economic, financial, customer, employment, and transactional datasets.
